answer_1.quote: Automatic text simplification (ATS) is a task that consists in automatically adapting a text to make it more accessible for readers.

answer_2.quote: automatic evaluation metrics represent a reproducible and quick way to measure the performance of ATS systems. The most common metrics currently used are: BLEU, a metric created to evaluate the performance of machine translation systems; SARI, a metric specifically designed for ATS; and the Flesch-Kincaid readability formula.
